item.title: Alexandra Eala Falls to Camila Osorio in Philippine Women’s Open Quarterfinals
item.description: Alexandra Eala lost to Camila Osorio in Philippine Women's Open quarterfinals early Thursday, ending the hometown tennis star's title quest. The post Alexandra Eala Falls to Camila Osorio in Philippine Women’s Open Quarterfinals appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Crash Threatens Olympic Participation As Winter Games Near
item.description: Lindsey Vonn suffered an injury in her final pre-Olympics race, with the 41-year-old airlifted while clutching her knee following the crash. The post Lindsey Vonn Crash Threatens Olympic Participation As Winter Games Near appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USWNT Star Crystal Dunn Announces Retirement from Pro Soccer
item.description: Longtime USWNT defender Crystal Dunn is retiring from pro soccer, after leading the US to a World Cup championship and Olympic gold medal. The post USWNT Star Crystal Dunn Announces Retirement from Pro Soccer appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UCLA Faces Iowa Women’s Basketball in Top-Ranked Big Ten Showdown
